memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic's scripts/check-module-invariants.sh, C14's C14_BASELINE and C14LEAN heredocs are compared by exact string equality and must be edited together, in identical declaration order, or the check HARD STOPs. A live `lake env lean` probe of a declaration must import the SAME module the heredoc's own `import` line uses (here, `import FormalSystem`, the whole library root) -- a narrower import (e.g. just the declaration's own submodule) can produce spurious 'unknown constant' errors for declarations that are only reachable transitively through a different import chain than expected, even though the declaration itself is real and compiles fine under the correct import.

When a plan prescribes trusting a pre-existing comment's stated numeric constant at face value for a recompute formula (e.g. 'C2's four'), re-verify that constant against the live tree before using it -- comments describing counts can go stale independently of the task at hand. In this case the script's own live census output (C36's 'N pinned declaration(s) in C2+C14') served as an independent corroborating source for the corrected total.
